title: Train Fault Library Standard Schema
description: JSON Schema for the Train Fault Library Standard (TFLS)

meta.description: Metadata about the train type and operator

name.description: Full name of the train type/model

code.description: Short code identifying the train type

yearIntroduced.description: Year when this train type was introduced to service

schemaVersion.description: Version of the TFRS schema being used

lastUpdated.description: Date when this fault reference was last updated

maintainer.description: Email contact for maintenance of this reference file

additionalNotes.description: Any additional notes about this reference file

manuals.description: Optional list of manuals that faults can reference. Manual PDFs are distributed alongside the .tfls file in a TFLS package (.tflsx)

id.description: Identifier for this manual, unique within the file. Faults reference manuals by this id

documentNumber.description: Optional document or part number of the manual

revision.description: Optional revision or edition of the manual

file.description: Optional path of the manual's PDF inside the TFLS package, relative to the .tfls file and using forward slashes (e.g. manuals/drivers-manual.pdf)

faults.description: List of all potential faults for this train type

faultCode.description: Optional identifier for the fault within this operator's systems

system.description: The train system to which this fault belongs

category.description: Severity or importance classification of the fault

description.description: Optional detailed description of the fault

symptoms.description: Optional observable symptoms of this fault

rectificationSteps.description: Optional steps to rectify the fault

notes.description: Optional additional notes, warnings, or special instructions

manualReferences.description: Optional references to the pages of manuals that cover this fault

manual.description: The id of a manual listed in meta.manuals

page.description: Optional page of the PDF to open, counting the first page of the file as 1 (not the printed page number)

section.description: Optional section number or heading in the manual (e.g. 4.2 Brake Cylinder Faults)
